title: Lockdown Drill
story: Ada meets the engineer in a warmly lit break room. The night floor's old input stations were locked under a training policy, and she will only open the security glass after explaining how to leave practice safely. The way back is on screen the whole time.

steps.objective: Talk to Ada by the kettle in the break room.
Enter the practice layer at the first console.
Check the silent keys in the safe text box.
Leave practice at the second console and confirm you are back on base.
Read the operations cards on the noticeboard.
Talk through the recovery scenarios with Ada.
Re-enter practice at the vestibule keypad and confirm how to leave.
Walk through the open security glass to the landing.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Enter the practice layer with the real Control + Alt + GUI + V, wait for the release, then confirm.
success_criteria: The scene observed Control, Alt, GUI (Meta) and V pressed together and then all four released.
The player confirms they toggled practice on; the UI states that it cannot detect the active layer.
Home-row holds and a lone V are rejected with feedback that names the observed output.

task.prompt: Hold physical Control, Alt (Option) and GUI (Command), tap V, then release every key.
task.layout: MacBook physical diagram by default; the Microsoft setup maps Alt to Command, Windows to Option and Right Alt to Right Command

steps.observe: keydown for Control, Alt, Meta and KeyV before any of them is released
keyup for all four keys; the scene waits for this before it continues

steps.player_confirm: I toggled practice on. (The game never claims to detect the layer.)

accepts: all four keydowns followed by all four keyups
rejects: home-row holds on A, S, D, F, J, K, L or ; (the toggle checks input real)

feedback.home_row_only: Observed: a home-row key held as a modifier. The toggle needs the real Control, Alt and GUI keys.
feedback.v_only: Observed: v. V alone still types v.
feedback.early_release: Observed: a key was released before the others. Hold all four, then release together.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: In a safe text box try physical Shift and physical Backspace and report what happened (a self-check, not proof).
success_criteria: The text box shows the observed output for each try, with no claim about which layer is active.
The player reports both results; either answer is accepted and recorded honestly in the journal.

task.prompt: Practice should now be on. Press physical Shift together with n, then physical Backspace, and say what you saw.

targets.practice_on: a plain n appears (no capital N): physical Shift is XX
nothing is erased: physical Backspace is XX

accepts: the player answers each question with what they saw
rejects: presenting the result as proof of the active layer

feedback.unproven: Observed output only. A matching result suggests practice is on, but the game cannot prove it.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Leave practice with the same four real keys, then show that physical Backspace works again.
success_criteria: The scene observed Control, Alt, GUI and V pressed together and released.
In the safe text box physical Backspace erases the last letter (observed output).
The player confirms they are back on base.

task.prompt: Press the same four real keys again, release them, then press physical Backspace once in the text box.

steps.observe: keydown for Control, Alt, Meta and KeyV
the text box content changes from "night" to "nigh"

accepts: the key sequence and the erase observed

feedback.no_erase: Observed: nothing erased. Practice may still be on: press the four keys again, or confirm that you are still in practice.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Read the reload card and the last-resort card; name the card that returns you to base (neither).
success_criteria: The player opens both cards; neither card asks for an in-scene action.
The player answers that the normal way back is the toggle on the exit card, not either card.

task.prompt: Open each card, then answer: which card returns you to base?

items.shows: Control + Shift + R is tap-hold A (Control), tap-hold J (Shift), then R. Plain Control + R stays available.
items.rule: operations card only; never a scored task

items.shows: physical Left Control + Space + Escape quits Kanata. Remapping stays off until Kanata is restarted. It is not the practice toggle.
items.rule: last resort only, with the restart step stated

question.prompt: Which card returns you to base?
choices: neither: press the toggle again (exit card)
question.answer: neither: press the toggle again (exit card)

rejects: asking the player to press Control + Shift + R or the emergency sequence in this scene

feedback.wrong: The reload card only reloads the configuration, and the last-resort card stops Kanata. The toggle on the exit card is the way back.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Choose the right recovery step in three stuck situations, ending with the last resort stated with its consequence.
success_criteria: Each situation is answered correctly, or the correction names the reason.
The last-resort answer includes the consequence (remapping stays off until Kanata is restarted).

task.prompt: Ada describes three situations. Pick what you do first.

items.situation: Letters still type, but Shift and Backspace do nothing.
choices: press the toggle again to return to base
items.answer: press the toggle again to return to base

items.situation: You edited the config and want it picked up.
choices: reload with the operations card (tap-hold A, tap-hold J, R)
items.answer: reload with the operations card (tap-hold A, tap-hold J, R)

items.situation: The toggle does nothing and every key behaves strangely.
choices: use the emergency exit only as a last resort and restart Kanata afterwards
items.answer: use the emergency exit only as a last resort and restart Kanata afterwards

rejects: any answer that treats the emergency exit as a layer toggle

feedback.toggle_confusion: The emergency exit is not a layer toggle. It quits Kanata, and remapping stays off until Kanata is restarted.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: At the security glass, re-enter practice, try legacy keys on the keypad (silent), and confirm the exit before the glass opens.
success_criteria: The keypad reports "Observed: nothing" for physical Return, a physical arrow and physical Backspace while practice is confirmed on.
The player confirms practice is on, then states how to leave (the toggle) and when to use the last resort.
The glass opens only after that confirmation; it never opens from an observed key alone.

task.prompt: Press the toggle to re-enter practice, then try the keypad with physical Return, a physical arrow and physical Backspace.

steps.observe: Control, Alt, Meta and V pressed and released

steps.player_confirm: To leave practice I press the same four real keys again; the emergency exit is only the last resort.

rejects: opening the glass without the exit confirmation

feedback.input_seen: Observed: the keypad received a key. Practice may be off: press the toggle, or confirm that it is off and continue honestly.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: You found the break room. The night floor locked its old input stations under a training policy, and I will not open the security glass until you know how to leave practice safely.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: To enter the practice layer, you need to press physical Control + Alt + GUI + V. Hint: Use the real modifier keys. The toggle checks `input real`, so home-row holds don't count, and V alone still types `v`. Press it again to return to base.

hint.action: To enter the practice layer, you need to press physical Control + Alt + GUI + V.
hint.gesture: Use the real modifier keys. The toggle checks `input real`, so home-row holds don't count, and V alone still types `v`. Press it again to return to base.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: Practice is a Kanata layer, not a game mode. You go in and out with the same four real keys, and the game only trusts what you tell it. Leave first, then fix whatever looks wrong.

dialogue.speaker: operations-card
dialogue.text: To reload Kanata, you need to press Control + Shift + R. Hint: tap-hold A (Control), then tap-hold J (Shift), then R. F would type `f`, because R is on the same hand.

hint.action: To reload Kanata, you need to press Control + Shift + R.
hint.gesture: tap-hold A (Control), then tap-hold J (Shift), then R. F would type `f`, because R is on the same hand.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: There is one more way out and I hope you never need it. It stops Kanata completely, and nothing remaps again until someone restarts it. Use the toggle first.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: To stop Kanata entirely, only as a last resort, you need to press physical Left Control + Space + Escape. Hint: Physical keys only. This is Kanata's emergency exit, not a layer toggle. All remapping stops until Kanata is restarted.

hint.action: To stop Kanata entirely, only as a last resort, you need to press physical Left Control + Space + Escape.
hint.gesture: Physical keys only. This is Kanata's emergency exit, not a layer toggle. All remapping stops until Kanata is restarted.

dialogue.speaker: exit-card
dialogue.text: To leave practice and return to base, you need to press physical Control + Alt + GUI + V again. Hint: Press it again to return to base. It is the same real modifier keys: home-row holds do not count, and V alone still types `v`.

hint.action: To leave practice and return to base, you need to press physical Control + Alt + GUI + V again.
hint.gesture: Press it again to return to base. It is the same real modifier keys: home-row holds do not count, and V alone still types `v`.

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: Journal: practice is player-confirmed. The browser cannot see which Kanata layer is active, so each practice scene labels its evidence.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: Then the glass is yours. I will walk with you as far as the lit route, and the exit card stays on your screen the whole way.
dialogue.cue: Ada: 17 once the player confirms and she walks alongside (pleased)

then.text: Exit card pinned to the HUD for the rest of Night Shift: leave practice with the same four real keys.

state_changes.before: Warm break room lit by lamp pools; the security glass is closed; the hall beyond is dark and the landing lamp is off.
state_changes.after: The security glass is open to a two-cell walkway, the landing lamp wakes, and Ada has walked the engineer to the start of the lit route.

visible_changes.note: the card reader beside the security glass turns from locked to open
the exit sign over the vestibule lights: the back exit stays clear
kit break_room set: the counter's lamp wakes and its warm pool settles on the counter top

review_notes: At 1366x768 (x4, letterboxed to 1280x720) every required break-room target (Ada, the consoles, the noticeboard, the elevator) sits at x >= 23, where the camera clamps to the south-east corner and keeps the avatar and the target clear of the keyboard inset (stage x 16-588, y 412-704). The vestibule keypad is the only target left of that line; it sits on row 13, above the inset. The lower-left of the break room (x 19-23, y 16-19) is decor only.
